description: Changes your own preferences. Send only what changes: language, theme (saved as the account default for new devices), calendar, notifications ([{category, email?, telegram?}] for categories that are live), contact_channel (email, phone, whatsapp, telegram or null) and marketing_opt_out:true to stop marketing messages. reset_notifications:true restores the default notification settings and needs confirm:true. Agreeing to marketing messages is not possible here (website only). Pass expected_rev from preferences_get to avoid overwriting a newer change.

contact_channel.description: Preferred way to be contacted; null clears it.

language.description: Language for emails, Telegram messages and notification links.

notifications.description: Per category channel switches (live categories only).

theme.description: Account default theme for new devices.

name: preferences_update
title: Update my preferences
